description: A settlement batch. Transactions are captured into a batch and submitted together for settlement and subsequent funding.

transactions.description: Transactions to settle. You can specify the transaction ID or the full resource URL. If empty, marks all the account's eligible transactions for settlement.

customReference.description: Optional reference provided by the merchant

customFields.description: Custom fields, an object containing arbitrary string values.  Field names and values must not exceed 64 and 1024 characters, respectively.
